en: Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a monumental statue ensemble on a richly decorated pedestal and fountain basin. A standing male figure in a long coat dominates the top, while several seated figures are positioned around the lower part of the structure. Rooftops and a tall tree appear in the background. The reverse side is a standard divided back with printed Hungarian text indicating the subject and publisher information.
